name: professional-slides
description: Create and revise editable PowerPoint decks.

interface.longDescription:
Professional Slides turns a brief, analysis, or existing presentation into an editable PowerPoint deck. It helps you develop the argument first, then choose the charts, tables, and layouts that make each point clear.

Use it for
• Board and steering committee papers, project updates, and executive summaries.
• Investor and pitch decks, due diligence, and competitive comparisons.
• Improving a storyline, sharpening titles, or revising individual slides.

How it works
• Share the audience, decision, evidence, and any reference deck or brand.
• Review the proposed storyline and slide titles before building.
• Create editable charts, tables, diagrams, and text in a consistent visual style.
• Inspect the rendered deck and its checks before delivery.

What you receive
An editable PPTX, with the argument, exhibits, and sources carried through the build. Revisions create a new file and preserve your original presentation. Supply your own evidence or ask for public research; the workflow records sources, separates facts from assumptions, and flags missing evidence.

The finished deck is rendered and independently reviewed. Check factual accuracy and source rights before sharing. This skill needs a local authoring environment; setup instructions, example slides, and a sample deck are available on the website.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $professional-slides to create or revise a decision-ready executive deck and verify the final editable artifact.
